offers.sn: Are you ready to take the lead in one of the most innovative fields in biotech?
offers.rq: You have a bachelor's or master's degree in science, bio-engineering, pharmacy or a related field of study or you are equivalent through experience. Or at least 3 years of experience in a GMP or ATMP environment (preferably in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry), and a drive for the new challenge of leading a team. Languages You speak and write fluent English.
